name: Marcus Bell
summary: Classmate with strong PyTorch and local-LLM experience who offered to review the LinkMate code.

notes.text: Marcus Bell - in my CECS 451 section. Sits in the back, knows PyTorch really well, has fine-tuned a couple of small LLMs with LoRA on his own GPU. Plays pickup basketball at the rec center on Tuesdays.

marcus offered to review our code before the phase 2 deadline, esp. the prompt/validation part. he also mentioned he got ollama running with a 12B model on his 3090 without problems -> could ask him about local model performance
